name: Brutalist Imperitor, Greater
body:
School transmutation [lawful]; Level cleric/oracle 8, paladin 4, sorcerer/wizard 8

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like lesser brutalist imperitor, except you gain low-light vision; DR 10/good; immunity to death effects, disease, mind-affecting effects, necromancy effects, paralysis, poison, sleep, and stun; a spell resistance of 11 plus your caster level, truespeech. Also, your regeneration increases to 10/chaos.

Truespeech allows you to speak with any creature that has a language, as though using the tongues spell.
